jobs.title: Supply Chain Analyst
jobs.jd: About the Company General Matter is enriching uranium in America. Our goal is to design, build, and operate the world’s lowest-cost enrichment services in the United States. Our mission is to restore America’s ability to produce nuclear fuel—fuel that will power AI, advanced manufacturing, critical industries, and the next generation of nuclear reactors. Ultimately, our work will help power national ambitions and enable a high-energy society. We were incubated by Founders Fund, like Anduril and Palantir before us, and are backed by top-tier investors. Our lean, world-class team of engineers and operators is applying a first-principles approach to solving the problem of nuclear fuel production. We are a mission-driven company with a culture of urgency, accountability, and transparency. Help us build a high-energy society by making the cleanest, safest form of baseload energy the most affordable. About This Role General Matter is building the supply chain that will put American-enriched uranium back into production, and we are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to keep our teams supplied with everything they need to build. In this role you will support the full range of supply chain functions—purchasing, vendor management, inventory, and data—working shoulder to shoulder with the engineers and operators building mission-critical hardware. You will own problems end to end, from sourcing a custom component to cleaning up the data that tells us what to buy and when. You will primarily operate for a functional area in the business: Software + I&C, Engineering, or Operations. The analyst role works directly with the engineers and operators to turn requirements into orders, ensure all needs are met, and maintain the organizational supply chain. Responsibilities Support procurement and purchasing of components, raw materials, and services for the departments you support, from requisition through delivery. Manage vendor and supplier relationships day to day—placing and expediting orders, tracking performance, and resolving supply issues before they slow the team down. Own category and vendor management for assigned commodities, including qualifying suppliers and negotiating for price, lead time, and availability. Track inventory, demand, and shortages, and give engineering and manufacturing clear visibility into what is clear-to-build. Maintain accurate master data in our ERP/MRP systems and build the reports and analysis the team needs to make fast, informed decisions. Build reports, dashboards, and cost models that drive decisions to capture and communicate the status of the supply chain program. Partner cross-functionally with engineers, operators, and other supply chain team members to identify problems and drive them to resolution with a bias for action. Basic Qualifications Evidence of exceptional ability (prior projects, portfolio of work, completed products, etc). Strong understanding of engineering fundamentals. Ability to perform trade studies and make clear recommendations using first principles and engineering fundamentals even with partial information. Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, Economics, or a related field. 2–3 years of experience in supply chain, procurement, planning, operations, or a related analytical role (internships included). Preferred Skills and Experience Experience in a fast-paced engineering or highly technical environment, with a resourceful approach to delivering under tight timelines or budget constraints. Hands-on experience with an ERP/MRP system (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Oracle). Strong data management and analysis skills, including advanced proficiency in Excel. Exposure to procurement or purchasing processes, including working with suppliers on lead times, MOQs, and price breaks. Experience in a hardware, manufacturing, aerospace, defense, or other highly technical environment. SQL, Python, or BI tools (Power BI, Tableau) experience. Experience buying to nuclear or other quality standards (e.g., NQA-1, 10 CFR Part 21, ISO 9001, AS9100). Additional Requirements: Ability to work extended hours and weekends as necessary. Equal Opportunity Employer General Matter is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with General Matter is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status. Compensation and Benefits The base salary range for this role is $100,000–$130,000 annually. Compensation bands are determined by role, level, location, and alignment with market data. Individual level and base pay is determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on job-related skills, education, experience, technical capabilities and internal equity. Please note that the stated salary range is an estimate and may be adjusted based on market conditions, business needs, or other factors. In addition to base salary, for full-time hires, you may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of stock options, and access to medical, vision & dental coverage as well as access to a 401(k) retirement plan.

jobs.title: Talent AI Operator
jobs.jd:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Help make AI-powered recruiting work reliably at scale in an early-stage recruiting technology company. You will oversee autonomous recruiting agents, apply human judgment to candidate conversations, and help shape how people and AI work together throughout the hiring process.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Monitor candidate conversations handled by AI agents, identify errors, and step in when human judgment is needed.

 - Guide senior candidates through complex conversations, objections, compensation discussions, and final hiring stages.

 - Review agent responses, label quality, and provide examples and feedback to improve performance.

 - Audit candidate matches, outreach quality, and conversion metrics across recruiting pipelines.

 - Manage offer discussions and help candidates complete placements successfully.

 - Document effective practices, create operating procedures, and build playbooks for human and AI collaboration.

 - Work with product, engineering, and company leadership to improve recruiting operations and agent behavior.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 2 years of experience in recruiting, sourcing, or talent operations at early-stage technology startups.

 - Hands-on experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar to evaluate outputs, identify errors, and understand limitations.

 - Experience closing placements and personally managing final-stage candidate conversations, including offer negotiation and objection handling.

 - Experience using recruiting data, such as KPIs, dashboards, A/B tests, or conversion analysis, to guide decisions.

 - Experience labeling outputs or providing feedback to improve AI, machine learning, or agent performance.

 - Comfort collaborating cross-functionally in a startup environment and creating operational documentation.

 - Familiarity with one or more of TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, or Supabase is helpful.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Competitive base compensation plus uncapped, performance-based pay tied to placements. Top performers may receive performance-based equity grants after a successful 90-day performance period. Health insurance and visa sponsorship are available.


LOCATION

Hybrid role based in San Francisco, California. An optional shared living and working space is available in San Francisco.

jobs.title: Pharmaceutical Data Scientist
jobs.jd: Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in agroscience Contract Research Organisation services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products. In over 30 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 58,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of 900 laboratories in over 54 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products. In 2021, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6.72 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years. We are seeking a highly motivated Data Scientist to join our team within the Pharmaceutical Small Molecule Materials Science Computational Sciences group. The successful candidate will work at the interface of materials science, scientific informatics, data science, artificial intelligence/machine learning, and computational tool development . This role will collaborate closely with experimental and computational scientists to develop scientific and automated workflows, data-driven approaches, AI/ML models, scientific applications, and informatics solutions that improve how scientific data are accessed, parsed, analyzed, connected, visualized, and used for decision making. The position offers an opportunity to contribute to an evolving computational-experimental ecosystem connecting scientific data, predictive models, AI, and experimental knowledge . Key Responsibilities Develop and apply data science, AI/ML, and informatics approaches to address Pharmaceutical Materials Science challenges. Build scientific data workflows, analytics, and visualization tools that enable effective use of experimental and computational data. Develop tools and pipelines to extract, transform, standardize, and integrate data from experimental & computational workflows Automate repetitive or manual scientific data-processing and analysis workflows to improve efficiency, reproducibility, and scalability Design, develop, validate, and deploy computational tools and scientific applications supporting research and development workflows. Integrate diverse scientific datasets to enable data-driven insights, predictive modeling, and decision making . Partner with experimental and computational scientists to identify high-value opportunities and translate scientific needs into practical digital solutions. Promote reproducible scientific computing, good software-development practices, and adoption of data and AI capabilities across the organization. Bachelors degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning, Bioinformatics, Cheminformatics, Computational Science, Chemistry, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering , or a related quantitative/scientific discipline. Strong programming skills, preferably in Python , with demonstrated ability to analyze data and develop computational solutions. Experience with Pharmaceutical data analysis, processing, scientific computing, statistics, machine learning, AI, or scientific informatics . Experience working with chemistry, pharmaceutical, materials-science, or laboratory-generated scientific data . Demonstrated ability to work with complex and heterogenous scientific datasets, including extracting, transforming, integrating, and analyzing structured and/or unstructured data. translate scientific questions into data-driven analyses or computational solutions. Familiarity with modern data-science, scientific computing, and machine-learning tools, libraries and frameworks. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Effective written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate within multidisciplinary scientific teams. Preferred Qualifications Experience developing scientific software, analytical applications, visualization tools, dashboards, automated workflows, or APIs. Experience with scientific databases, data integration, metadata, ontologies, knowledge graphs, or scientific informatics. Hands-on experience developing or applying machine-learning, deep-learning, generative-AI, or large-language-model approaches . Familiarity with modern software-development practices, including Git/version control, testing, documentation, and reproducible computing . Experience developing interactive scientific applications and user interfaces, including notebook-based environments such as Jupyter/JupyterLab and web-based frameworks or visualization platforms. Experience with cloud computing, high-performance computing, or scalable data-processing environments. Demonstrated ability to take a scientific problem from raw data → structured data → analysis/model → automated workflow or usable computational solution . Position is Monday- Friday 8:00 AM- 5:00PM. Overtime as needed. May be requested to work on weekends, overtime, and holidays based on business needs Candidates currently living within a commutable distance of Groton, CT are encouraged to apply. Excellent full-time benefits, including comprehensive medical coverage, dental, and vision options Life and disability insurance 401(k) with company match Paid vacation and holidays #LI-EB1 Authorization to work in the United States indefinitely without restriction or sponsorship Eurofins USA PSS Insourcing Solutions is a Disabled and Veteran Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

jobs.jd: Job Description: WSJ Newsroom | Data Analyst (September 2026) Title: Data Analyst, Newsroom Analytics The Wall Street Journal is seeking a Data Analyst to join our newsroom data team, reporting to the Senior Manager, Newsroom Analytics. You will work alongside our senior analysts to produce the reports, dashboards, and analyses the newsroom relies on to make editorial, audience, and product decisions every day. This role is a chance to build real analytical range in a fast-moving newsroom environment. You will spend most of your time in SQL, pulling data, building and maintaining dashboards, and helping the newsroom get answers quickly. You will use AI tools to accelerate this work, building lightweight utilities and automations that improve efficiency across the team and free up time for deeper analysis. You will collaborate closely with more senior colleagues as you take on progressively more independent work, from ad hoc analyses to experiment analysis and measurement projects. This position will be based in our New York office. You will: Write SQL to answer questions from newsroom editorial, audience, and product partners, translating requests into clean, well-scoped queries and clearly communicated results. Build and maintain dashboards and recurring reports that expand self-serve access to newsroom data. Support deep-dive analyses on major news events, high-priority moments, and shifts in performance. Help keep the reporting stack reliable by troubleshooting data quality issues, tracing problems back to their source, and partnering with data engineering to resolve them. Contribute to A/B tests and experiment analysis in partnership with senior analysts, growing into independent experiment ownership over time. Learn the newsroom's taxonomies, instrumentation, and foundational datasets, and help maintain shared documentation and analytical patterns the team pulls from. You have: 1 to 2 years in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field, or an equivalent internship and project background. Proficient SQL skills, with experience writing queries against non-trivial datasets. Comfort with a modern BI or dashboarding tool (Looker, Tableau, Mode, or similar). Curiosity and speed in picking up new technical concepts and frameworks, and a track record of getting productive on unfamiliar stacks. Strong written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to explain data clearly to non-technical partners. Care for accuracy and detail in work the newsroom will act on. Standout candidates will have strengths in one or more of the following: Experience with large-scale data warehouses like BigQuery or Snowflake, or with dbt. Familiarity with Python for analysis, data wrangling, or automation, and comfort maintaining code in Git. Exposure to A/B testing and applied statistics. A background or strong interest in journalism, media, or content, and enthusiasm for driving journalistic outcomes. Comfort using AI/LLM tooling to speed up analytical workflows. jobs.title: Innovation & Data Analytics, Associate – Liquidity & Financing
jobs.jd: About this role Your team The Innovation, Data & Analytics (IDA) team sits across Liquidity & Financing (L&F) within BlackRock Global Markets and Index Investments (BGM). BGM brings together Index Investments, Global Trading, ETF Markets, and Liquidity & Financing, which encompasses Securities Lending, Securities Financing, and Cash Management. IDA operates across L&F within the COO function and is focused on enabling the next generation of innovation and data-driven decision making. The team is leading the evolution of L&F's in-business data platform, driving AI adoption and citizen development, delivering centralized reporting and business intelligence capabilities, and exploring emerging technologies that can create meaningful business impact. Your role and impact We are seeking an Associate to join the IDA team in New York. This role provides an opportunity to work at the intersection of financial markets, data, analytics, and innovation, translating complex business challenges into scalable solutions. You will work across Securities Lending, Securities Financing, and Cash Management and collaborate with program and product managers, data engineers, trading professionals, client professionals, and other partners across the firm. Your work will help expand L&F's analytical capabilities, develop differentiated data and insights, modernize our data platform and tooling, and identify practical applications for AI and emerging technologies. Your responsibilities In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities: Innovation & Emerging Technology: Research, evaluate, document, and test new and emerging technologies, identifying opportunities to generate revenue, improve productivity and scale, and mitigate risk. Derived Data Strategy: Develop proprietary business data transformations and analytical logic through deep-dive research into trading, market, product, and client dynamics. Analytics & Business Intelligence: Partner within multidisciplinary teams to develop and expand analytics and business intelligence capabilities based on business impact and demand. Data Platform & Tooling: Contribute to the development and evolution of L&F's data platform and tooling, enabling scalable access to trusted data and supporting data-driven decision making. Partnerships & Collaboration: Build and expand data, analytics, and research partnerships with key stakeholders across L&F and the broader firm. Your experience Undergraduate or graduate degree in a quantitative field such as Engineering, Finance, Mathematics, Computer Science, Operations Research, or a related discipline, with strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. 4+ years of relevant experience in data strategy, analytics, or technology innovation within financial services or a related setting; experience in Securities Lending, Securities Financing, Cash Management, or adjacent markets is preferred. jobs.jd: Posting Date 11/12/2026 2000 16th Street, Denver, Colorado, 80202, United States of America DaVita is seeking a detail-oriented, analytical, and growth-minded Financial Analyst to join our National Hospital Services Group (HSG) FP&A team. This role reports to the Manager of FP&A and will support key recurring planning, forecasting, reporting, and business-performance processes for the HSG business. The Financial Analyst will build a strong foundation in monthly financial results, treatment-volume forecasting, revenue forecasting, operational reviews, and the annual budget process. This role offers meaningful exposure to HSG finance and operations leaders, with opportunities to contribute analyses and, over time, present findings to the Senior Director of Finance and other HSG leadership. jobs.title: Strategic Finance Analyst
jobs.jd:
ABOUT POSTHOG

PostHog is your product’s context layer. It ingests and stores your analytics, errors, replays, and business data so you and your agents can query and act on it.

We launched out of Y Combinator's W20 cohort https://posthog.com/handbook/story. We've since shipped more than a dozen products, including:

 - A suite of analytics and observability tools, including product analytics https://posthog.com/product-analytics, replay vision https://posthog.com/replay-vision, AI observability https://posthog.com/ai-observability, and error tracking https://posthog.com/error-tracking

 - PostHog MCP https://posthog.com/mcp for users and their agents to query and act on their product and business data

 - Data warehouse https://posthog.com/context-warehouse/managed-warehouse so users can query product and customer data together using custom SQL insights.

We are:

 1. Product-led. More than 500K organizations have installed PostHog, mostly driven by word-of-mouth. We have intensely strong product-market fit.

 2. Default alive https://paulgraham.com/aord.html. Revenue is growing incredibly quickly, and we're very efficient. We raise money to push ambition and grow faster, not to keep the lights on.

 3. Well-funded. We've raised more than $180m from some of the world's top investors. We're set up for a long, ambitious journey.

We're focused on building an awesome product for end users, hiring exceptional teammates, shipping fast, and being as weird as possible https://posthog.com/deskhog. 

 


THINGS WE CARE ABOUT

 - Transparency: Everyone can read about our roadmap, how we pay (or even let go of) people, our strategy, and how we work, in our public company handbook https://posthog.com/handbook. Internally, we share revenue, notes and slides from board meetings, and fundraising plans, so everyone has the context they need to make good decisions.

 - Autonomy: We don’t tell anyone what to do. Everyone chooses what to work on next based on what's going to have the biggest impact on our customers, and what they find interesting and motivating to work on. Engineers lead product teams https://posthog.com/handbook/wide-company and make product decisions https://posthog.com/handbook/which-products. Teams are flexible and easy to change when needed.

 - Shipping fast: Why not now? https://posthog.com/handbook/values#why-not-now We want to build a lot of products; we can't do that shipping at a normal pace. We've built the company around small teams – autonomous, highly-efficient groups of cracked engineers https://posthog.com/founders/cracked-manifesto who can outship much larger companies because they own their products end-to-end.

 - Time for building: Nothing gets shipped in a meeting. We're a natively remote company. We default to async communication – PRs > Issues > Slack. Tuesdays and Thursdays are meeting-free days https://posthog.com/handbook/company/culture#were-on-the-makers-schedule, and we prioritize heads down building time over perfect coordination. This will be the most productive job you've ever had.

 - Being weird: Weird means redesigning an already world-class website for the 5th time. It means shipping literally every product that relates to customer data. It means building an objectively unnecessary developer toy https://posthog.com/deskhog with dubious shareholder value. Doing weird stuff is a competitive advantage. And it's fun.


JOB SUMMARY

Help us understand how PostHog grows, what that growth costs, and what we should plan for next. Working directly with our Finance team, you’ll own the day-to-day consolidated financial model, expense planning, and board reporting, with their guidance. You’ll explain differences between actual results and plans, partner with team leads on hiring and spending decisions, and ask thoughtful questions that challenge our assumptions.




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

 - Corporate planning and consolidation
   
   - Maintain the integrated three-statement forecast: income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow. Keep actuals, assumptions, and scenarios consistent and easy to follow.
   
   - Own the quarterly board pack and investor reporting. Report costs versus plan each month and explain what changed. Support fundraising analysis when needed.

 - Operating expenses and business partnering
   
   - Work with team leads to track hiring and vendor spending. Update the forecast each month and explain changes.
   
   - Set up monthly planning reviews so team leads can see their spending outlook and discuss changes.

 - Revenue and commercial analysis
   
   - Support Mine's revenue modeling, check inputs and calculations, document assumptions, and explain performance versus plan.
   
   - Run the weekly revenue update when Mine is out.

 - Example public issues/projects:
   The models and board materials are internal. These links provide public context for example projects.
   
   - Build a consolidated forecast and monthly reporting pack. Public context: Finance team https://posthog.com/teams/finance
   
   - Build a headcount and vendor-spend forecast that shows what changed each month and which decisions need review. Public context: Spending money https://posthog.com/handbook/people/spending-money
   
   - Build an infrastructure cost forecast and show how cost per product changes as usage grows. Public context: Pricing and usage-based products https://posthog.com/pricing




WHAT YOU WON'T BE DOING

❌ Sales Ops execution (deal desk, contracts, credits/refunds, commission calculations, policy implementation)

❌ Accounting close, revenue recognition, collections, and the GL

❌ Billing-system engineering or ownership of the data platform. The analyst uses and checks these teams' outputs for planning.

 


REQUIREMENTS

 - Build and debug an integrated three-statement model in Excel or Google Sheets. Make assumptions explicit, add checks, and test scenarios.

 - Turn an unclear business question into a model. Separate facts from assumptions and explain which inputs drive the answer.

 - Reconcile model outputs to source data and investigate discrepancies. Keep forecasts and reporting accurate and up to date.

 - Explain why results differ from plan, get useful inputs from team leads, and follow up on missing information.

 - Ask questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and want to learn how a software business works.

 - AI is part of how you work. You use tools to build and check models, write SQL, and automate reporting, and you can show us examples of this.

 - Work in a small team where processes are still being built.

If you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you - we're happy to accommodate! 

#LI-DNI

jobs.title: Financial Analyst - Healthcare
jobs.jd: McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care. What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you. The Financial Analyst will support financial planning, analysis, and reporting for 3PL (Third Party Logistics), a business segment within CoverMyMeds. You’ll partner closely with Accounting, FP&A, operations leaders, and cost center owners to turn financial results into actionable insights, with particular focus on revenue, gross profit, operating expenses, forecasting, and the monthly close. What You'll Do Analyze financial performance and deliver timely, actionable insights that support business decisions. Develop and maintain Excel-based financial models, forecasts, budgets, long-range plans, and ad hoc analyses. Analyze revenue, gross profit, and operating expense performance against budget, forecast, prior periods, and strategic plans. Own monthly operating expense reporting for assigned categories and consolidate results across cost centers to explain total segment performance. Identify key financial drivers, risks, and opportunities and translate results into concise commentary for business leaders. Partner with cost center owners to understand spending trends, vendor commitments, contracts, and headcount-related costs and incorporate those drivers into forecasts. Support month-end close by reviewing financial results and helping identify accruals, reclassifications, corrections, and other accounting needs before close. Prepare variance explanations and supporting materials for post-close reviews with business leaders and cost center owners. Maintain financial controls and supporting documentation to help ensure accurate, timely, and reliable reporting. Collaborate with Accounting, operations, FSS, and Corporate and business-unit FP&A teams on financial analysis and planning. Lead ad hoc financial and planning projects by clarifying objectives, evaluating assumptions, and developing recommendations with limited supervision. Identify opportunities to make financial reporting, forecasting, reconciliation, and close processes faster and more reliable. Build repeatable reporting using Excel, Power BI, and enterprise planning and reporting systems. Apply AI and automation tools, including Copilot and Power Automate, to streamline recurring data pulls, reconciliations, analysis, and first-draft financial commentary. Cross-train across FP&A responsibilities and provide backup support to the broader team. Skills You’ll Need Bring 3+ years of experience in accounting, finance, financial analytics, FP&A, or a comparable discipline. Hold a bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field. Apply working knowledge of month-end close, journal entries, accruals, financial statements, and variance analysis. Build and maintain financial models and analyze large data sets with strong attention to accuracy and detail. Identify root causes behind financial results and translate complex data into clear recommendations. Explain financial performance effectively to both finance and non-finance audiences, including senior leaders. Manage multiple priorities and projects while meeting competing deadlines in a fast-paced monthly close environment. Demonstrate sound judgment and maintain appropriate confidentiality and controls when handling sensitive financial information. Build productive relationships across Finance, Accounting, operations, and other business functions. Take ownership of work, proactively investigate issues, and operate effectively with limited supervision. Preferred Skills Bring experience in corporate FP&A, management reporting, or a shared-services finance environment. Demonstrate experience in healthcare, healthcare IT, pharmacy, pharmaceutical, logistics, or distribution environments. Use large ERP and enterprise planning systems, such as SAP, alongside advanced Excel and Power BI capabilities. Apply automation and AI tools, such as Copilot or Power Automate, to improve recurring finance processes. Demonstrate experience with driver-based forecasting, annual budgeting, and long-range planning. Hold an MBA, CPA, or other relevant advanced finance or accounting credential. Demonstrate strong ethical judgment, relationship building, communication, teamwork, organization, planning, and problem-solving skills. Thrive in a collaborative, hands-on environment that values initiative, continuous improvement, and accountability. Location: Columbus, Ohio, Dallas/Ft. Worth. jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.jd: The NeuroAI Lab at UCSF, is hiring a Data Scientist to support and advance our research initiatives at the intersection of AI and cognitive neuroscience. The successful candidate will contribute to a multidisciplinary team developing cutting-edge AI systems for the discovery, diagnosis, and care of neurodegenerative diseases. The Data Scientist will work across the lab’s core research areas, including: (1) foundation AI models that leverage large-scale clinical databases to identify disease subtypes and risk factors; (2) agentic AI decision support systems that synthesize multimodal patient data for specialist-level diagnoses; and (3) AI conversational agents for scalable clinical assessments. The role involves designing and maintaining robust data pipelines, curating and analyzing complex multimodal datasets (clinical notes, neuropsychological assessments, neuroimaging), developing and evaluating machine learning models, and contributing to research publications. The ideal candidate will have strong programming skills and experience with generative AI and traditional ML algorithms, a passion for translational research, and the ability to work effectively across disciplines. This position offers exceptional opportunities for professional growth at the forefront of health AI, with direct exposure to world-class clinical collaborators and the potential to impact real-world patient care. Department Description: The NeuroAI Lab operates at the UCSF Memory and Aging Center-Department of Neurology - Weill Institute for Neuroscience . We are also affiliated with the Bakar Computational Health Sciences Institute and the Center for Intelligent Imaging (ci2) . % of time Essential Function (Yes/No ) Key Responsibilities (To be completed by Supervisor) 20% Plans long-term statistical studies, including the preparation of proposals, design of survey instruments and determining sampling procedures. 20% Gathers, analyzes, prepares and summarizes the collection of information and data; recommends statistical approaches, trends, sources and uses. 5% Prepares data for presentation. 10% Identifies multivariate strategies. 5% Prepares reports of studies for internal validation and cross validation studies. 5% Analyzes the interrelationships of data and defines logical aspects of data sets. 10% Develops systems for organizing data to analyze, identify and report trends. 10% Manages database of research data for projects. 5% Reviews new software instruments and potential effects on statistical testing. Proficiency in Python, with demonstrated experience in data analysis, machine learning, and statistical modeling. Experience building and maintaining data pipelines, integrating APIs, and working with large-scale datasets. Familiarity with version control (Git) and collaborative software development practices. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and manage multiple projects. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. jobs.title: Audience Data Analyst, Opinion
jobs.jd: Job Description: About the Team: The Wall Street Journal is a global news organization that provides leading news, information, commentary and analysis. The Wall Street Journal engages readers across print, digital, mobile, social, podcast and video. Building on its heritage as the preeminent source of global business and financial news, the Journal includes coverage of U.S. & world news, politics, arts, culture, lifestyle, sports, and health. It holds 38 Pulitzer Prizes for outstanding journalism. The Wall Street Journal is published by Dow Jones, a division of News Corp (Nasdaq: NWS, NWSA; ASX: NWS, NWSLV). The WSJ Opinion section has long served as a forum for intelligent, values-driven commentary, dedicated to advocating a consistent philosophy that can be summed up as ‘free markets, free people.’ While we aim to persuade, every word we publish is the product of rigorous reporting, research and debate. WSJ Opinion offers sharp, original analysis and strong points of view on the news of the day. This position supports the Opinion section’s audience data and insights work. About the Role: The Wall Street Journal’s Opinion section is seeking an Audience Data Analyst based in New York to support our audience reporting and editorial performance tracking. Reporting directly to the Manager of Audience Data Analysis and Insights, you will be responsible for tracking audience trends, updating reporting dashboards, and translating audience behavior into clear takeaways for editorial leadership. You will assist in compiling recurring reports and ad-hoc analyses covering Opinion, Free Expression, Books and Arts in Review across web, mobile apps, newsletters, video, and podcasts. This is a hybrid role based in New York, with an expectation of working in the office three days per week. You Will: Extract, validate, and analyze reach, engagement, and subscription data from Snowflake using SQL to support editorial decision-making. Help build, update, and maintain dashboards and reporting views in Tableau. jobs.jd:
About us:

Jerry.ai http://Jerry.ai is a Series C, YC-backed tech startup with 5M+ customers and $240M in funding. Founded in 2017, product launched in 2019, and achieved profitability in 2024.

 

Why we exist:

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

 

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

 

We are building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets. We started with your car in 2019, now we’re expanding into new verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, boat).



Why We’re Hiring

Our Data Science & Analytics team has been a force multiplier and accelerant to our business that has helped us reach these pivotal milestones in spite of headwinds and within a highly competitive market. They are a team of former McKinsey, BCG and Bain consultants who drive data & insights, and inform decision-making across every corner of our business. They are analytical powerhouses and first principles problem solvers who push forward our most important initiatives across product, growth, tech, and operations.

Every business unit has a Data Science team member embedded within it  —  someone who doesn't just run analyses and build dashboards, but shapes what questions we should ask, what data to pull, what conclusions to draw, what decisions to make, and then drives our teams towards our next goal: go from 5M to 50M customers and become a $10B business in the next 4 years. 

 

As our business continues to expand, there is growing demand for more Data Science team members. We are hiring 2-3 people to drive impact in these areas:

 - Growth Marketing 

 - Product Development

 - Strategic Partnerships 

 

On leveling: You may see job ads for this role at different job levels. Our priority is finding the right people, we can be flexible with job title/leveling.



Why You Will (Or Won't) Like Working Here

 - No slides: If you've worked in consulting, you know what it feels like to be up at 3am reformatting a deck. That doesn't exist here. The only work that gets done at Jerry is work that will materially change the trajectory of our business — an important product, a new growth channel, a key metric, a critical partner relationship, etc. 

 - No corporate fluff: The Data Science & Analytics team is 14 insatiable learners who care deeply about solving difficult problems and making a tangible impact. Every person owns a critical domain. There is no bloat, unnecessary meetings, or waiting for approvals. 

 - Hands-on: This is not a pure strategy role, you will also own execution. Your day-to-day will be surfacing analytical insights, driving decisions, and seeing them through end-to-end. 



What You'll Own

You'll sit on our central Data Science & Analytics team but you’ll be embedded in one of Jerry's core business areas — growth, product, AI and automation, strategic partnerships — and own the analytical function for that business unit end-to-end.

 - Define the right problems: Before any analysis, understand what business question it's answering and what decision it will inform. Push back if the question is flawed.

 - Data and insights: Define metrics, build reports, run analyses, design experiments, and surface data insights that move your team's key metrics.

 - Drive outcomes: Bring recommendations to your counterparts in product, growth, finance or operations, tell them what's happening and why, and what next steps should be.

 

Who You Are

 - First principles thinker: You break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses before touching data. You're analytically strong (comfortable with SQL or Python) but your instinct is to ask "what are we trying to solve here?" before jumping to "what should I build?" 

 - Direct communicator: You can walk a skeptical stakeholder through a complex finding and get buy-in quickly. You write clearly, speak precisely, and don't bury the lede.

 - Owner: You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside of your swim lane.

 

What You'll Bring

 - 2+ years of experience at a consulting firm, investment bank, or high-growth technology company.

 - Strong analytical skills; ability to pull, structure, and interpret data independently.

 - Track record of owning ambiguous problems and delivering impact.

 - Clear, persuasive communicator who can influence decisions at the leadership level.

 

Our Tools

SQL (Clickhouse), Metabase, Python, Jupyter Hub, GitHub.

 
 

While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.

jobs.title: Associate, Business Operations & Analytics
jobs.jd:
About us:

Jerry.ai http://Jerry.ai is a Series C, YC-backed tech startup with 5M+ customers and $240M in funding. Founded in 2017, product launched in 2019, and achieved profitability in 2024.

 

Why we exist:

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

 

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

 

We are building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets. We started with your car in 2019, now we’re expanding into new verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, boat).

 

Why We’re Hiring

Our Business Operations & Analytics  team has been a force multiplier and accelerant to our business that has helped us reach these pivotal milestones in spite of headwinds and within a highly competitive market. They are a team of former McKinsey, BCG and Bain consultants who drive data & insights, and inform decision-making across every corner of our business. They are analytical powerhouses and first principles problem solvers who push forward our most important initiatives across product, growth, tech, and operations.

 

Every business unit has a Business Operations & Analytics team member embedded within it  —  someone who doesn't just run analyses and build dashboards, but shapes what questions we should ask, what data to pull, what conclusions to draw, what decisions to make, and then drives our teams towards our next goal: go from 5M to 50M customers and become a $10B business in the next 4 years. 

 

As our business continues to expand, there is growing demand for more Business Operations & Analytics team members. We are hiring 2-3 people to drive impact in these areas:

 - Growth Marketing 

 - Product Development

 - Strategic Partnerships 

 

On leveling: You may see job ads for this role at different job levels. Our priority is finding the right people, we can be flexible with job title/leveling.

 

Why You Will (Or Won't) Like Working Here

 - No slides: If you've worked in consulting, you know what it feels like to be up at 3am reformatting a deck. That doesn't exist here. The only work that gets done at Jerry is work that will materially change the trajectory of our business — an important product, a new growth channel, a key metric, a critical partner relationship, etc. 

 - No corporate fluff: The Business Operations & Analytics team is 14 insatiable learners who care deeply about solving difficult problems and making a tangible impact. Every person owns a critical domain. There is no bloat, unnecessary meetings, or waiting for approvals. 

 - Hands-on: This is not a pure strategy role, you will also own execution. Your day-to-day will be surfacing analytical insights, driving decisions, and seeing them through end-to-end. 

 

What You'll Own

You'll sit on our central Business Operations & Analytics team but you’ll be embedded in one of Jerry's core business areas — growth, product, AI and automation, strategic partnerships — and own the analytical function for that business unit end-to-end.

 - Define the right problems: Before any analysis, understand what business question it's answering and what decision it will inform. Push back if the question is flawed.

 - Data and insights: Define metrics, build reports, run analyses, design experiments, and surface data insights that move your team's key metrics.

 - Drive outcomes: Bring recommendations to your counterparts in product, growth, finance or operations, tell them what's happening and why, and what next steps should be.

 

Who You Are

 - First principles thinker: You break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses before touching data. You're analytically strong (comfortable with SQL or Python) but your instinct is to ask "what are we trying to solve here?" before jumping to "what should I build?" 

 - Direct communicator: You can walk a skeptical stakeholder through a complex finding and get buy-in quickly. You write clearly, speak precisely, and don't bury the lede.

 - Owner: You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside of your swim lane.

 

What You'll Bring

 - 1+ years of experience at a consulting firm, investment bank, or high-growth technology company.

 - Strong analytical skills; ability to pull, structure, and interpret data independently.

 - Track record of owning ambiguous problems and delivering impact.

 - Clear, persuasive communicator who can influence decisions at the leadership level.

 

Our Tools

SQL (Clickhouse), Metabase, Python, Jupyter Hub, GitHub.

 
 

While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.

About EliseAI

At EliseAI, we're improving the industries that matter most: housing and healthcare. Everyone needs a place to live and access to quality healthcare, yet both are often harder to secure than they should be. 

By integrating AI agents deeply into existing workflows, we make them more efficient, reduce costs, and improve the experience for everyone.



 - Housing: We simplify how renters tour apartments, sign leases, submit maintenance requests, and stay connected with their property team—bringing everything they need for their home into one place.

 - Healthcare: We make it easy to schedule appointments, complete intake forms, and we help patients communicate with providers, so everyone can focus on health instead of paperwork.
   
   

With EliseAI, organizations reduce manual work, improve accessibility, and deliver a seamless experience across essential services. We recently raised a $350 million https://eliseai.com/blog/intelligence-is-getting-cheaper-life-should-too funding round at a $4 billion valuation led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Bessemer Venture Partners to accelerate this mission.



About The Role 

EliseAI’s Product Solutions team are subject matter experts responsible for solving issues and answering questions for our customers. Our Product Solutions Analysts possess in-depth system knowledge on our individual client configurations and systems and configuration data access. The Product Solutions team works with other internal teams to troubleshoot customer issues and ensure the best possible customer experience.



Key Responsibilities

 - Provide tier 1 and tier 2 technical support to clients via Zendesk, our ticketing system, ensuring timely resolution of issues

 - Investigate, troubleshoot, and fix complex technical issues and escalate to appropriate internal teams when necessary

 - Maintain clear documentation and communication with clients throughout the support lifecycle, and approach each interaction with a customer-obsessed mindset

 - Collaborate with the other teams in Product Solutions to relay user feedback, identify recurring issues, run audits and contribute to product improvements

 - Maintain and update internal knowledge base articles, FAQs, and user guides to enhance self-service support options and reduce incoming ticket volume

 - Run Quality Assurance check on our Support AI Chatbot and provide ongoing coaching to ensure proper responses for issue resolution

 - Attract top-tier talent to join our driven team



Move at rocket speed, build something massive.

We’re scaling fast, solving real client problems with precision and ambition. Here, you own your impact; full autonomy, no micromanagement, no fluff. We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll ever do. If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard.



Requirements

Nice to haves include

Why Join

Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in on the ground floor of a funded (unicorn! https://www.eliseai.com/blog/eliseai-raises-250m-series-e) startup that’s scaling so fast. That means that instead of following a playbook, you’ll be writing it. Every single day you will be challenged to identify how we can scale and execute on it. Benefits

In addition to the growth and impact you’ll have at EliseAI, we offer competitive salaries along with the following benefits:

jobs.title: Customer Data Analyst
jobs.jd:
ABOUT US

Fieldguide is establishing a new state of trust for global commerce and capital markets through automating and streamlining the work of assurance and audit practitioners specifically within cybersecurity, privacy, and financial audit. Put simply, we build software for the people who enable trust between businesses.

We’re based in San Francisco, CA, but built as a remote-first company that enables you to do your best work from anywhere. We're backed by top investors including Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Bessemer Venture Partners, 8VC, Floodgate, Y Combinator, DNX Ventures, Global Founders Capital, Justin Kan, Elad Gil, and more.

We value diversity — in backgrounds and in experiences. We need people from all backgrounds and walks of life to help build the future of audit and advisory. Fieldguide’s team is inclusive, driven, humble and supportive. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture that we are building, seeking teammates that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Fieldguide is looking for a Customer Data Operations Analyst to help build and operationalize the data foundation that connects how customers use Fieldguide with how we measure, understand, and communicate the value they receive from the platform.

This role will sit at the intersection of Customer Success, Product, Data Science, and GTM Operations, translating real-world customer needs into scalable data models, trusted reporting, and actionable insights. The role will combine strong SQL and analytics capabilities with hands-on data modeling and reporting, ensuring customer data is accurate, accessible, and built to scale.

While this role will participate in select customer meetings, QBRs, and onsite engagements to understand reporting requirements firsthand, the majority of the role will be hands-on—developing and customizing reports, querying and validating data, building and maintaining data models, and addressing gaps in the underlying data infrastructure. You will then partner with Product and Data Science to ensure the right information is captured, structured, validated, and surfaced consistently.

The goal is to create a trusted customer data foundation that enables Fieldguide and its customers to answer critical questions around product adoption, engagement, efficiency, time savings, ROI, value realization, and business outcomes.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN


CUSTOMER DATA REPORTING & INSIGHTS

 - Own the development and customization of customer-facing reports and dashboards, translating customer requirements into accurate and actionable reporting.

 - Use SQL and existing data infrastructure to investigate customer questions, validate reported metrics, and resolve discrepancies.

 - Build scalable reporting solutions that can be reused across customers, service lines, and engagement types.

 - Partner with Customer Success to support data-driven QBRs, executive business reviews, renewals, and value realization conversations.

 - Identify where customer-specific reporting requests reveal broader gaps in Fieldguide's underlying data models or product reporting capabilities.

 - Work with Product and Data Science to move frequently requested reporting from manual/custom analysis toward standardized and productized capabilities


DATA MODELING & ANALYTICS

 - Develop and maintain scalable data models that support customer reporting, QBRs, value realization, and product analytics.

 - Write advanced SQL to extract, transform, validate, and analyze customer and product data across multiple data sources.

 - Build and maintain data models and transformations to create reliable, reusable downstream datasets.

 - Identify gaps in existing data models and address legacy data quality, modeling, and structural issues that impact reporting accuracy.

 - Translate recurring one-off reporting requirements into standardized, scalable data models and reporting infrastructure.

 - Partner with Data Science and Data Engineering to determine when customer reporting requirements should be addressed through analytics, data modeling, upstream product instrumentation, or broader infrastructure changes.

 - Establish reusable datasets and semantic definitions that enable consistent reporting across customers rather than recreating logic for individual accounts.

 - Reduce manual and one-off reporting by identifying opportunities for automation and standardized reporting.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Success in this role means Fieldguide has a trusted, scalable customer data foundation rather than relying on fragmented or one-off analysis.

 - Customer-facing metrics have clear definitions, sources, methodologies, and owners.

 - Customer teams can confidently use data in QBRs and executive conversations.

 - Product usage and customer outcomes can be connected to measurable value.

 - Data discrepancies are identified and addressed at their source.

 - Customer feedback systematically informs Product and Data priorities.

 - Recurring customer data requests become standardized and automated where possible.

 - Fieldguide can increasingly demonstrate defensible ROI and value realization.

 - Customer reporting becomes consistent across QBRs, renewals, and strategic engagements.

 - Product and Data teams have a clear understanding of the information customers need from Fieldguide.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 2+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Analytics Engineering, Data Operations, Business Intelligence, Customer Analytics, or a related technical data role.

 - Advanced SQL skills with demonstrated experience querying, transforming, validating, and troubleshooting complex datasets.

 - Strong understanding of dimensional data modeling, data transformations, metric definitions, and analytics architecture.

 - Strong understanding of data quality, validation, governance, and operational workflows.

 - Ability to translate business and customer questions into structured data requirements.

 - Strong analytical skills and comfort working with large or complex datasets.

 - Experience creating dashboards, reports, and executive-level data narratives.

 - Excellent communication skills, particularly the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience at a B2B SaaS or enterprise software company.

 - Hands-on experience with dbt, including building, maintaining, testing, and documenting scalable data models.

 - Experience supporting Customer Success, QBRs, value realization, or customer analytics.

 - Familiarity with audit, advisory, accounting, or professional services workflows.

 - Experience working with product telemetry and customer usage data.

 - Experience partnering directly with Data Science or Analytics Engineering teams.



More about Fieldguide:

Fieldguide is a values-based company. Our values are:

 - Fearless - Inspire & break down seemingly impossible walls.

 - Fast - Launch fast with excellence, iterate to perfection.

 - Lovable - Deliver happiness & 11 star experiences.

 - Owners - Execute & run the business with ownership.

 - Win-win - Create mutual value & earn trust for life.

 - Inclusive - Scale the best ideas with inclusive teams.

Some of our benefits include:

 - Competitive compensation packages with meaningful ownership

 - Flexible PTO

 - 401k

 - Wellness benefits

 - Technology & Work from Home reimbursement

 - Flexible work schedules

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Preparedness
jobs.jd:
About the Team

The Preparedness team is an important part of the Safety Systems https://openai.com/safety/safety-systems org at OpenAI, and is guided by OpenAI’s Preparedness Framework https://openai.com/index/updating-our-preparedness-framework/.

Frontier AI models have the potential to benefit all of humanity, but also pose increasingly severe risks. To ensure that AI promotes positive change, the Preparedness team helps us prepare for the development of increasingly capable frontier AI models. This team is tasked with identifying, tracking, and preparing for catastrophic risks related to frontier AI models.

The mission of the Preparedness team is to:

 1. Closely monitor and predict the evolving capabilities of frontier AI systems, with an eye towards misuse risks whose impact could be catastrophic to our society

 2. Ensure we have concrete procedures, infrastructure and partnerships to mitigate these risks and to safely handle the development of powerful AI systems

Preparedness tightly connects capability assessment, evaluations, and internal red teaming, and mitigations for frontier models, as well as overall coordination on AGI preparedness. This is fast paced, exciting work that has far reaching importance for the company and for society.

 

About the Role

We’re hiring a Data Scientist to help build, evaluate, and continuously improve mitigations that prevent extreme harms from AI systems. This role is for an experienced, highly autonomous individual contributor who can take ambiguous problem statements, structure rigorous analyses, and translate findings into actionable product and policy changes.

This position goes beyond “running evals.” You’ll help create mitigation intelligence and monitoring systems that enable OpenAI to detect issues early, measure effectiveness over time, and reduce both over-blocking (unnecessary friction) and under-blocking (missed harm).





WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Evaluate and improve mitigation systems, including classifiers and detection pipelines across domains (e.g., biosecurity, cybersecurity, and emerging risk areas).

 - Diagnose false positives and false negatives with deep error analysis, root cause investigation, and clear recommendations for mitigation adjustments.

 - Build monitoring and measurement frameworks to track mitigation effectiveness over time and across user segments and use cases.

 - Identify trends in over-blocking vs. under-blocking, quantify customer impact, and propose prioritized interventions.

 - Develop insights from customer feedback, complaints, and usage patterns to detect shifts in adversarial behavior and system failure modes.

 - Expand risk monitoring into new areas, including cybersecurity threats and model loss-of-control or sabotage scenarios, in partnership with domain experts.

 - Communicate results to technical and executive stakeholders with crisp narratives, decision-ready metrics, and clear tradeoffs.

You might thrive in this role if you are:

 - An autonomous operator: you can take a problem statement and independently structure the analysis end-to-end.

 - Strong at executive-ready communication: concise, clear, and outcome-oriented.

 - Skilled in turning analysis into productable changes: you’re comfortable influencing across functions to drive mitigation improvements.


QUALIFICATIONS

 - Significant experience in data science or applied analytics in high-stakes domains (e.g., security, trust & safety, abuse prevention, fraud, platform integrity, or reliability).

 - Strong foundations in experimentation, causal thinking, and/or observational inference; ability to design robust measurement under imperfect data.

 - Fluency in SQL and Python (or equivalent) for analysis, modeling, and building monitoring workflows.

 - Experience building metrics, dashboards, and operational monitoring that meaningfully changes outcomes (not just reporting).

 - Track record of driving cross-functional impact with engineering, product, and research partners.

 - Cybersecurity data science experience (strong preference), including exposure to threat modeling, adversarial dynamics, abuse patterns, or security telemetry.

 - Experience with classifier evaluation, calibration, thresholding, and error analysis at scale.
   Familiarity with detection systems in adversarial settings (e.g., evasion, distribution shift, feedback loops).

 - Trust & Safety experience is helpful, but not required.

 - Genuine interest in AI safety, alignment, and catastrophic risk prevention.



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

jobs.title: Analyst, Partner Strategy
jobs.jd:
Cambio is a software platform that drives world-class real estate decarbonization. We help commercial real estate owners and tenants bring their real estate portfolios to net-zero using a machine learning-driven, end-to-end real estate sustainability platform. Our mission is to take the real estate industry into the climate action era.

As a Partner Strategy Analyst at Cambio, you will play a pivotal role in owning end-to-end data quality assurance for some of the world’s leading institutions who have chosen Cambio to manage their carbon accounting, benchmarking, reporting, and decarbonization efforts — including helping clients understand and act on building performance standards (BEPS) and other regulatory requirements. If you enjoy tackling quantitative problems, have a passion for climate-related work, and are excited about the idea of working at a fast-paced team at the forefront of climate, AI and real estate technology, this role is for you!



Key Responsibilities

 - Support onboarding for large institutional clients, assessing existing data sources and creating tailored onboarding plans.

 - Work with asset and property management teams to automate data collection and ensure smooth data ingestion.

 - Oversee end-to-end data quality assurance, transforming raw data into standardized, accurate inputs for Cambio’s platform and resolving issues with product and engineering teams.

 - Own all quantitative analytics delivered to customers, ensuring complete accuracy and high-quality outputs.

 - Build and maintain building-level energy, water, and carbon benchmarks (e.g., ENERGY STAR Portfolio Manager) that give clients a clear, defensible view of asset performance relative to peers and regulatory thresholds.

 - Track jurisdiction-specific building benchmarking and Building Performance Standards (BEPS) requirements — such as NYC Local Law 97, DC BEPS, and BERDO — monitoring compliance deadlines and fine exposure, and translating pathway options into clear guidance for property and asset management teams.

The Warranty Analyst contributes by investigating warranty and goodwill claims, analyzing expense and repair trends, and reviewing vehicle buyback cases to identify and document the defective causal parts or conditions associated with repurchase. Are you detail-oriented, analytical, and motivated to turn complex information into actionable findings? You’ll evaluate warranty and goodwill performance, investigate unusual claim patterns, and collaborate with Quality Engineers and internal stakeholders to identify areas requiring further review. You’ll also support vehicle buyback analysis by reviewing repair histories and related records to identify and document the initial and final defective causal parts and/or conditions that led to vehicle repurchase under applicable lemon laws. As a member of the warranty support team, you’ll: Analyze warranty expenses and prepare monthly comparisons against forecasts, prior-month results, and prior-year performance. Review powertrain warranty expenses, including coverage under HMA’s 10-year/100,000-mile powertrain warranty. Analyze quarterly cost-per-unit trends by month in service, including failure rates, claim costs, and labor operation codes across warranty, goodwill, and campaign repairs. Identify significant cost variances, emerging concerns, and unusual claim patterns; communicate findings and recommend further investigation. Monitor goodwill expenses, support forecasting, and identify campaign-related costs and dealers with high expenses and low customer satisfaction results. Analyze warranty repair data alongside technician training records to identify potential relationships between training gaps and repeat repairs. Review dealer use of labor operation codes and warranty repairs, coordinating with Regional Warranty Managers when excessive or unusual activity requires investigation. Conduct repair-sequence and repair-narrative analyses to assess dealer repair efficiency and potential effects on vehicle quality. Review vehicle buyback repair records, service orders, and customer communications to identify the initial and final defective causal parts and/or conditions associated with repurchase. Collaborate with Quality Engineers and internal departments to clarify technical findings and accurately document buyback conclusions. Enter and maintain warranty, claim, and buyback findings in designated internal systems. Prepare reports, presentations, and ad hoc analyses for management. Participate in training and product-information exchanges; travel, including overnight stays, may be required for up to four weeks annually. Support occasional vehicle testing, service coordination, and other related assignments as directed. Technical Expertise Strong understanding of automotive repair procedures, diagnostic methods, and vehicle systems. Ability to interpret repair orders, warranty claims, service histories, and technical documentation. Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Access, PowerPoint, and Word. Ability to analyze warranty costs, failure rates, claim trends, and forecast variances. Strong data-entry accuracy and documentation practices. Desired Skills Strong analytical, mathematical, and root-cause investigation skills. Exceptional attention to detail when reviewing technical records and documenting findings. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to explain analytical findings clearly to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. Strong organization, prioritization, multitasking, and follow-up skills. Ability to collaborate with client personnel, dealership staff, engineers, and warranty teams. Advanced Excel and PowerPoint proficiency is a plus. Required Qualifications High school diploma or equivalent. Experience in automotive repair and product quality. Demonstrated ability to analyze complex data and develop clear findings and recommendations. Strong computer proficiency, including database querying and Microsoft Office applications. Ability to manage multiple assignments while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines. Preferred Qualifications Four-year degree in engineering. Dealership fixed operations and warranty experience. At MSX International, you’ll apply your automotive knowledge and analytical skills to meaningful warranty and product quality challenges. Working on-site at the headquarters provides opportunities to collaborate with warranty, quality, and engineering professionals while broadening your understanding of manufacturer operations. If you’re ready to turn technical records and warranty data into actionable insights, we want to hear from you. jobs.title: Data Scientist, Analytics Enablement
jobs.jd:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Strategic Finance Data Science team helps OpenAI understand business performance and make informed decisions about growth, revenue, and resource allocation. We partner with Strategic Finance, Data Engineering, and business teams to build trusted metrics, explain what is changing, and support forecasting, planning, pricing, and investment decisions.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Data Scientist, Analytics Enablement to turn complex financial and business questions into reliable data products, clear analyses, and actionable recommendations. You will work across the analytical workflow: define the question, establish trustworthy metrics and datasets, investigate the drivers, and help partners act on the findings.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will combine the technical depth of analytics engineering with strong analytical judgment and close partnership with Strategic Finance. Your work will serve both executive reviews and the teams making day-to-day business decisions.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Define and maintain trusted metrics and analytical datasets for revenue, usage, customer performance, compute consumption, and margin, with clear definitions and appropriate product, customer, and cohort detail.

 - Build automated dashboards and recurring reporting that help Finance leaders and operating teams understand performance, spot changes, and prioritize investigation.

 - Explain movements in business results and variances against expectations by examining underlying drivers, validating data quality, and distinguishing evidence from assumptions.

 - Translate ambiguous questions about growth, retention, monetization, pricing, and resource efficiency into structured analyses and practical recommendations.

 - Partner with forecasting specialists and Finance to provide reliable inputs, driver analyses, and scenario assumptions for forecasts and long-range plans.

 - Work with Data Engineering to improve the quality and usability of underlying data, and develop reusable analytical models and workflows that reduce manual effort.

 - Communicate findings clearly, align stakeholders on trade-offs, and follow through to understand whether the analysis or data product improved the decision.




YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU

 - Have strong SQL and analytical data-modeling skills, and experience turning large, complex datasets into reliable analyses and reusable data products.

 - Can reason carefully about metrics, cohorts, denominators, measurement changes, and uncertainty, and investigate whether an unexpected result reflects the business or the data.

 - Have built dashboards or recurring reporting used by business partners, and can explain the decisions they enabled.

 - Bring sound business judgment and can independently scope an ambiguous problem, prioritize the work, and deliver an end-to-end solution.

 - Communicate technical findings clearly and work effectively with Finance, data scientists, engineers, and other business partners.

 - Can use Python or a comparable analytical tool to investigate data and automate repetitive work.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.jd: Summary: The Data Scientist, Marketing Analytics serves as a core analytical authority on ADT’s marketing efforts, translating complex customer, campaign, and media data into high-value, predictive, and actionable insights. This role bridges the gap between advanced data science and strategic marketing operations, working with stakeholders to solve critical business problems like predicting high-value customer acquisitions, optimizing media spend, and supporting our company's growth, customer lifetime value (LTV), and digital personalization objectives. The ideal candidate combines strong technical capabilities in machine learning, statistical modeling, and data engineering with an understanding of consumer behavior, marketing technology (MarTech), and executive storytelling. They will work alongside the Marketing Analytics Leader, data analysts, data engineers, and channel managers to build scalable, evidence-based solutions that directly influence ADT’s customer acquisition and retention strategies. Duties and Responsibilities: Predictive Growth Modeling: Apply advanced statistical methods, machine learning (e.g., classification, survival analysis), and clustering to predict customer lifetime value (LTV), model acquisition propensity, and identify customer churn risk. Attribution & Mix Modeling: Support the development of Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) and multi-touch attribution (MTA) frameworks to help business leaders understand and act on marketing efficiency issues. Campaign Experimentation: Design and execute evidence-based research and scientific hypothesis testing (A/B and multivariate testing) around digital marketing campaigns, creative assets, and landing page personalization. Executive Data Storytelling: Translate highly complex statistical findings into clear, beautiful, and intuitive visualizations and compelling narratives that drive strategy, action, and decision-making at executive levels. Data Engineering & Pipelines: Collaborate with data platform and engineering teams to design, implement, and maintain robust data pipelines that integrate ad-platform APIs, web analytics, and offline sales data into a continuous, single-source-of-truth. Privacy & Compliance: Implement and champion rigorous data privacy standards and ethical data collection practices, navigating how to effectively target and optimize campaigns while respecting consumer privacy regulations (e.g., CCPA/CPRA, cookie changes). Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner directly with Brand, Digital Media, Demand Gen, and Product Marketing teams to frame vague marketing challenges into structured, measurable data science initiatives. Continuous Improvement: Stay current on evolving marketing technology trends, MLOps best practices, and innovative data sources to elevate ADT's analytical maturity from descriptive reporting to prescriptive action. Customer Segmentation: Experience creating and defining customer personas and segmentation to deliver personalized experiences throughout the customer lifecycle. Minimum Qualifications: Education: Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) in Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or a related highly quantitative field. (Master's degree preferred). Experience: 3+ years of directly applicable experience in data science, predictive modeling, and building end-to-end data pipelines within a marketing or customer acquisition context. Technical Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in (Python with deep experience in data modeling packages. Advanced SQL skills and experience manipulating high-dimensional consumer datasets. Proficiency using Vertex AI/Colab notebooks. Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of digital marketing channels (Paid Search, Paid Social, Programmatic), web analytics platforms (e.g., Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics), and MarTech/AdTech ecosystems. Ambiguity Management: Proven ability to navigate dynamic, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial environments with ambiguous or evolving project requirements. Familiarity with Customer Data Platforms (CDP) in supporting no code/low code Marketer driven target audiences. Communication Skills: Writing, Talking/Hearing on the phone (Continually=67-100% of workday) Environment Requirements: Remote/Home office (Continually=67-100% of the workday) Travel: Occasionally, less than 25%
