jobs.title: Analyst, Applied Validations
jobs.jd:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

Pilots don't train with real passengers. Actors don't rehearse with real audiences. Yet, the most consequential decisions in society are often pushed straight to production.



Simile is changing that. We have built the first AI simulation of society, populated by generative agents based on real humans. Our research pioneered the field of AI-based simulation, proving it is possible to model human behavior with high accuracy. Today, we are developing a Foundation Model to predict human behavior in any situation, at any scale.



We have raised $300M in total funding, with a $2B post-money valuation in our latest round. Our investors include Greenoaks, Index Ventures, Hanabi, A*, Bain Capital Ventures, Factory, CVS Health Ventures, and Definition.




ABOUT THE ROLE

At Simile, accuracy is the product. Enterprise buyers want proof that Simile matches what their customers actually say and do, and as an Applied Validations Analyst, you will own that proof. You'll design and run customer validations and backtests that compare Simile's simulated results against real-world ground truth, then diagnose gaps, explain what the evidence supports, and identify opportunities to improve performance.



You'll work alongside Solutions Consultants and Deployments, and be deeply embedded with our Modeling, Evals, and Data teams. You'll turn one-off studies into repeatable, scalable workflows that build customer trust in a new category of AI. You'll identify patterns across customer validations and work with Modeling, Evals, Data, and Product to turn those findings into improvements, and test whether those improvements address the gaps.



This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who enjoys writing code, investigating data, and learning new methods while working at the pace of customer engagements.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Study Scoping: Scope validation and backtest studies with Solutions Consultants, Deployments, and customers. Pick the right use case, agree on metrics and success criteria up front, and flag studies that won't produce a meaningful comparison. Guide teams on which validation approaches are appropriate given current model and product capabilities.

 - Simulation & Comparison: Run simulations and compare them against human ground truth using industry standard evaluation metrics.

 - Diagnosing Misses: Break down gaps by segment and population to determine drivers of differences around methodology, model, data, or sampling. Identify recurring patterns across validations to distinguish isolated gaps from systematic gaps. 

 - Closing the Loop: Translate validation gaps into reproducible examples and concrete recommendations for Modeling, Evals, Data, and Product. Partner with these teams on follow-up experiments, evaluation coverage, and data, and retest whether changes address the gaps.

 - Reusable Tooling: Build Python pipelines, API-driven experiments, and LLM skills for repeatable validation loops. .

 - Customer Readouts: Write clear readouts showing where the model is strongly aligned and where it is more directional, and present them to technical and business stakeholders.
   
   


REQUIREMENTS


MUST HAVES

 - Statistics & Analytical Judgment: A solid foundation in statistics, including sampling, variability, correlation, and bias. You can question data quality, recognize misleading comparisons, investigate differences across populations and segments, and assess whether conclusions are supported by the evidence.

 - Learning & Iteration: Demonstrated ability to learn unfamiliar methods and tools quickly, investigate unexpected results, and improve an approach through structured experimentation. You are motivated to build expertise in customer validations and backtesting.

 - Technical & AI-Native Workflow: Ability to use Python and APIs to analyze data and run reproducible experiments, including using Claude Code, Codex, or similar coding agents to accelerate the work. You can review and validate the outputs these tools produce.

 - Communication & Commercial Judgment: You can turn analysis into a clear narrative, explain results and limitations to technical and business audiences, and connect findings to customer decisions and priorities.

 - Collaboration & Follow-Through: You can translate findings into actionable recommendations, work with Modeling, Evals, Data, and Product teams to address gaps, and document lessons that help others move faster.
   
   


NICE TO HAVES

 - Validation & Model Improvement: Experience running backtests and evaluating predictive models.

 - Evaluation Methods: Familiarity with holdout datasets, data leakage, and testing whether improvements generalize to unseen examples.

 - Human Study & Measurement Methods: Familiarity with survey & human study design, panel sampling, distributional comparisons such as TVD, choice-based methods, or differences between stated intent and observed behavior.

 - Research Background: Experience in behavioral research, market research, consumer insights, survey science, or a research-agency analytics team.

 - Survey Platforms: Experience with Qualtrics or similar survey platforms and panel providers.

 - Customer-Facing Technical Work: Experience in applied data science, technical consulting, or presenting analytical findings to customers.
   
   

Compensation & Benefits

At Simile, we provide competitive compensation packages that include base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits.

 - Salary Range: $200,000 – $300,000 USD
   
   - Note: Final offers are based on experience, specialized skills, interview performance, and relevant training.

 - Equity: Grants are available for eligible roles, subject to board approval.

 - Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage.

 - Time Off: Flexible time off policies to support work-life balance.
   
   


OUR PROCESS

We prioritize thoughtful conversations and clear examples of past work. Our hiring journey is designed to help both sides align on fit, working style, and expectations.



Reapplication Policy: To ensure a fair and thorough evaluation for all applicants, Simi




COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY & INCLUSION

Equal Opportunity: Simile is an equal opportunity workplace. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities, valuing an environment where everyone can contribute authentically.



Accommodations: If you require support or reasonable accommodations during the application process due to a disability, please let us know. We are happy to assist.

jobs.jd:

David AI is the first audio data research company. We bring an R&D approach to data–developing datasets with the same rigor AI labs bring to models. Our mission is to bring AI into the real world, and we believe audio is the gateway. Speech is versatile, accessible, and human—it fits naturally into everyday life. As audio AI advances and new use cases emerge, high-quality training data is the bottleneck. This is where David AI comes in.

 

David AI was founded in 2024 by a team of former Scale AI engineers and operators. In less than a year, we’ve brought on most FAANG companies and AI labs as customers. We recently raised a $50M Series B from Meritech, NVIDIA, Jack Altman (Alt Capital), Amplify Partners, First Round Capital and other Tier 1 investors.

 

Our team is sharp, humble, ambitious, and tight-knit. We’re looking for the best research, engineering, product, and operations minds to join us on our mission to push the frontier of audio AI.



ABOUT OUR DATA SCIENCE TEAM

Our Data Science team turns the activity across our business into the insights, metrics, and data foundations that guide how we grow. We move fast, own our work end-to-end, and partner closely with product, engineering, research, operations, and go-to-market to make sure the company is working on the right problems, measuring what matters, and drawing data backed conclusions.







ABOUT THIS ROLE

As a Data Scientist at David AI, you'll turn our data into decisions. You'll help figure out what we should be building, measure whether it's working, and lay the foundation for how the company defines, stores, and trusts its data.







IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Work cross-functionally to identify the highest-leverage business problems and drive them to resolution.

 - Define core metrics that measure the health of our business, products, and operations, and own the data dictionary that keeps them consistent across the company.

YOUR BACKGROUND LOOKS LIKE

 - 3+ years of experience working on a cross-functional team as a product Data Scientist.

 - Experience working in a fast paced environment where you owned your work end-to-end.

 - Proficiency with AI coding tools and agentic workflows, grounded in the SQL and Python skills needed to validate their output.
   
   




BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE

 - Experience with audio data, data research companies, or LALM evaluations.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.jd:
ABOUT SOLACE

Healthcare in the U.S. is fundamentally broken. The system is so complex that 88% of U.S. adults do not have the health literacy necessary to navigate it without help. Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions—and get better outcomes.

We're a Series C startup, founded in 2022 and backed by Inspired Capital, Craft Ventures, Torch Capital, Menlo Ventures, Signalfire, and IVP. Our U.S. based team is lean, mission-driven, and growing quickly.

Solace isn't a place to coast. We're here to redefine healthcare—and that demands urgency, precision, and heart. If you're looking to stretch yourself, sharpen your edge, and do the best work of your life alongside a team that cares deeply, you're in the right place. We’re intense, and we like it that way.

Read more in our Bloomberg funding announcement here https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-02-10/vcs-give-solace-health-1-billion-valuation-for-patient-advocacy-tech?accessToken=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzb3VyY2UiOiJTdWJzY3JpYmVyR2lmdGVkQXJ0aWNsZSIsImlhdCI6MTc3MDczMDg4MywiZXhwIjoxNzcxMzM1NjgzLCJhcnRpY2xlSWQiOiJUQThVUzhLR0NURzEwMCIsImJjb25uZWN0SWQiOiJBRDYxODI0MTc0ODM0MTk0QTRENUZFNzkwMzNGMDJGNSJ9.TE2pFUAOQAPMUXFlzoQ7zeJvctq7cSibbZqtIwhW-2U&leadSource=uverify+wall.




ABOUT THE ROLE

At Solace, data isn't just about understanding the past; it's about predicting the future. We are a rapidly scaling startup where we work hard, move fast, and wear many hats.

The Solace Data Team is looking for a Data Scientist who excels at forecasting, prediction, and machine learning to help us anticipate patient needs and optimize our operations. Reporting directly to the VP of Data, you will have the opportunity to lead high-impact projects that directly influence our strategic decision-making.

In this role, you will go beyond descriptive analytics to build the predictive engines that drive our business. Whether you are forecasting operational volume, modeling patient risk, or designing rigorous A/B tests, you will bridge the gap between advanced statistics and practical business application, ensuring our models are robust, interpretable, and impactful.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build Predictive Models: Develop and refine machine learning models to solve critical business problems, such as predicting patient churn, estimating operational volume, or scoring advocate quality.

 - Drive Forecasting Rigor: Own the development of time-series forecasts that guide our capacity planning and resource allocation. You will help us anticipate "what comes next" with higher accuracy.

 - Design & Analyze Experiments: Lead the design and analysis of A/B tests and causal inference studies. You will ensure we measure the true impact of our product and operational changes.

 - Uncover Deep Insights: Apply advanced statistical methods to complex datasets to find patterns that simple reporting might miss. You will answer the "why" and "how" behind our most difficult questions.

 - Productionize Solutions: Work closely with Data Engineers to take your models from a local notebook to a production environment, ensuring they run reliably within our data infrastructure.

 - Communicate Complexity: Translate complex statistical findings into clear, actionable narratives for non-technical stakeholders. You will be the voice of statistical reason in strategic discussions.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - Statistical Expertise: You have a strong background in statistics, probability, and mathematics (e.g., hypothesis testing, regression analysis, time-series forecasting).

 - Python & ML Proficiency: You are fluent in Python and its data science ecosystem (pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels, NumPy). You write clean, reproducible code.

 - Forecasting Experience: You have hands-on experience with time-series analysis and forecasting techniques (e.g., ARIMA, Prophet, exponential smoothing).

 - Advanced SQL: You can write complex queries to wrangle your own data from Snowflake without relying solely on others to prepare it for you.

 - Preferred Masters Degree or PHD: Data Science, Applied Science, or related fields.

 - Data Privacy Awareness: You understand the importance of protecting patient data. You are familiar with best practices for handling PHI and PII and ensuring privacy in your analysis.

 - Startup DNA: You are a self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity. You take ownership of problems and are willing to wear many hats to get the job done.


BONUS POINTS

 - Deployment Experience: Experience using tools like Docker, Airflow, or MLflow to deploy and monitor models in production.

 - Healthcare Experience: Experience working with healthcare or insurance claims data is a plus.

 - NLP & Unstructured Data: Experience applying Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques to extract insights from unstructured text data.

 - Marketplace Matching: Experience designing matching algorithms or ranking systems for two-sided marketplaces.

 - dbt & Engineering Skills: Comfort reading or writing dbt models to understand the lineage of your data.

Applicants must be based in the United States.



Up for the Challenge? 

We look forward to meeting you.

All legitimate communications come from official solace.health emails only or ashbyhq.com http://ashbyhq.com. Report suspicious activity to recruiting@solace.health or advocate@solace.health.

As a Logistics Analyst , you will play a key role in supporting logistics operations through data-driven insights and performance analysis. This position is responsible for developing and delivering comprehensive reports, analyzing transportation and distribution metrics, and identifying trends and opportunities for improvement. Whether supporting Supply & Demand Planning, product transportation, or Direct Store Delivery, the Logistics Analyst helps optimize our supply chain by turning data into actionable strategies. WHAT YOU’LL DO: The below statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. May perform other duties as assigned. Data Analysis & Reporting: Perform complex analyses and generate reports to monitor logistics performance and support strategic planning. KPI Tracking & Forecasting: Analyze weekly and monthly key performance indicators and forecasts to evaluate operational efficiency. Cost Analysis: Interpret logistics cost components and provide insights to support cost control and optimization efforts. TMS & Carrier Data Management: Maintain and update carrier information in the Transportation Management System (TMS) to ensure accurate costing and freight payment. Carrier Setup & Auditing: Manage new carrier setups and audit accessorial charges to ensure billing accuracy and compliance. Transportation Performance Monitoring: Track transportation performance against carrier awards and cost targets to ensure alignment with strategic goals. Optimization Modeling: Apply mathematical models and optimization techniques to design efficient logistics networks and support executive decision-making. Freight Settlement Accuracy: Review and correct freight settlement documents to ensure proper accruals and financial accuracy. Cost Estimation for New Business: Collaborate with business leaders to estimate distribution costs for new opportunities, including freight and distribution center expenses. Communication & Stakeholder Engagement: Communicate effectively with senior leaders, vendors, and customers to support logistics initiatives and resolve issues. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential functions. Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree from an accredited four-year college or university in Supply Chain Management, Business Management, or a related field and 2+ years of relevant experience in Transportation, Logistics, or Customer Service; or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Technical Proficiency: Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Access. Analytical Skills: Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities to interpret data and drive decisions. Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills for effective collaboration across teams. Organizational Skills : Highly organized and detail-oriented with a focus on delivering quality work. Customer Service: Demonstrated excellence in customer service and responsiveness to internal and external stakeholders. Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with shifting priorities. Team Collaboration: Proven ability to work well with others and contribute to a collaborative team culture. Professionalism: Respectful, approachable, and team-oriented demeanor that fosters strong working relationships. Positive Work Environment: Commitment to building and maintaining a positive, inclusive, and productive workplace. OTHER SKILLS THAT MAKE YOU STAND OUT: Advanced knowledge and experience with Sequel Data Base is preferred. Relevant work experience in a Shipping or Carrier Company is preferred. jobs.jd: DB E.C.O. North America (with “E.C.O.” representing “ E ngineering, C onsulting and O perations") offers specialized rail and transit consultancy services to public agencies, passenger and freight railroads. DB E.C.O. North America is part of the DB E.C.O. Group and leverages Deutsche Bahn’s global expertise to advance mobility and rail transportation across the U.S. and Canada. Their cross-disciplinary team collaborates closely with clients to innovate their portfolios and elevate business performance. With a focus on sustainability, safety, and operational excellence, they strive to enhance the customer experience, increase rail usage, and “Transform The Future Of Mobility.” Departmen t: Consulting, Rail Operations Reports to: Principal Location: New York City, or Washington, D.C. o r Sacramento, CA (In-person) The Financial Analyst will support economic, financial, and business analyses across transportation, rail, transit, and infrastructure projects. The position is not assigned to a single client or program and may support multiple projects as well as internal business needs. The role contributes to cost estimating, financial planning, affordability assessments, business case development, funding analyses, and strategic recommendations for public- and private-sector clients. The position requires strong analytical capabilities, proficiency in financial modeling and data analysis, and the ability to translate complex findings into clear, practical recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences. The analyst will work independently and as part of multidisciplinary project teams in a consulting environment where assignments, clients, and priorities may vary over time. Tasks and Responsibilities: Support economic, financial, and business case analyses for transportation, rail, transit, and infrastructure projects. Develop and maintain cost estimates, financial models, forecasts, affordability assessments, and scenario analyses. Conduct life-cycle cost, sensitivity, risk, and investment analyses to support project and management decisions. Collect, validate, clean, and analyze financial, operational, market, and project-related data from diverse sources. Perform quality checks on models, calculations, assumptions, and source data to support reliable and defensible analysis. Prepare analytical inputs for grant applications, funding proposals, financing strategies, and investment plans. Conduct market research, benchmarking, and comparative analyses relevant to transportation and infrastructure programs. Create tables, charts, dashboards, visualizations and associated descriptive text to communicate analytical results clearly. Contribute to reports, presentations, business cases, proposals, and briefings for clients and internal stakeholders. Support project financial monitoring, including budgets, forecasts, variances, and management reporting, as required. Support internal commercial analyses, including project budgets, fee estimates, utilization, profitability considerations, and related management reporting, as required. Develop and improve analytical tools, models, templates, databases, and methodologies. Document assumptions, data sources, methodologies, limitations, and recommendations in a clear and traceable manner. Collaborate with internal teams and client stakeholders. Manage assigned analyses independently, prioritize competing tasks, and deliver high-quality work within agreed schedules. Requirements: Masters degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field or Bachelor's degree with 3+ years of relevant professional experience or graduate degree. Demonstrated quantitative, analytical, and data modeling skills through professional experience and/or academic coursework. Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including financial modeling, data analysis, and structured documentation of assumptions. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including PowerPoint and Word. Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present analytical findings to varied audiences. Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple assignments. Self-directed, dependable, and able to work independently with limited supervision while contributing effectively to a team. Preferred skills and experience: Cost estimating, financial modeling, forecasting, budgeting, or business case development. Public transportation, rail, transit, infrastructure, engineering, or management consulting. Public-sector projects, transportation agencies, infrastructure owners, or public funding programs. Procurement, pricing, grants, funding, financing, or commercial analysis. Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Python, R, and/or other data analytics and visualization tools. Working with multidisciplinary teams and preparing client-facing deliverables. Working Conditions and Travel : Minimal overnight travel by land and air. jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.jd: Data Scientist Build AI That Accelerates Scientific Discovery Do you want your work to help researchers solve humanity’s biggest challenges? At Elsevier, data science is not about building models for the sake of building models. It is about advancing scientific discovery, improving healthcare outcomes, and helping researchers, clinicians, educators, and institutions unlock knowledge that can improve lives around the world. Every day, millions of scientists rely on our products to discover evidence, connect ideas, validate findings, and advance research. As a Data Scientist, your work will directly contribute to the tools and technologies that help accelerate human progress. About the Team As part of a growing team of Data Scientists, you will take on some of the hardest problems in science. This team is building intelligent systems that can reason across scientific publications, research data, knowledge graphs, ontologies, metadata, taxonomies, citations, and content spanning every scientific discipline. About the Role As a Data Scientist at Elsevier, you will design, develop, and deploy AI and machine learning solutions that power knowledge discovery across the global research ecosystem. You will work with one of the world's richest collections of scientific information, including publications, citations, research datasets, metadata, ontologies, knowledge graphs, and multidisciplinary content spanning every scientific field. This role combines cutting-edge AI with meaningful impact. You will help build intelligent systems that make scientific knowledge more discoverable, trustworthy, connected, and actionable. What You'll Do Design and deploy machine learning, NLP, and generative AI solutions that help researchers discover, understand, and apply scientific knowledge. Build intelligent retrieval, search, recommendation, ranking, and question-answering systems that improve research outcomes. Develop AI systems that connect information across publications, datasets, citations, knowledge graphs, and scientific ontologies. Fine-tune, evaluate, and integrate large language models and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems into production environments. Create robust evaluation frameworks that measure quality, reliability, relevance, trustworthiness, and user impact. Build scalable data pipelines and machine learning workflows that support experimentation, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Apply the appropriate combination of classical machine learning, deep learning, retrieval, and generative AI techniques to solve complex scientific problems. Collaborate with engineering, product, UX, analytics, and domain experts to transform ambiguous challenges into practical solutions. Contribute clean, maintainable, production-quality Python code and reusable AI components. Continuously improve the capabilities, performance, and real-world value of AI systems that support scientific discovery. What We're Looking For Degree in Data Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative discipline. Extensive Python programming skills and experience building production-quality data science solutions. Experience with machine learning fundamentals, including model development, evaluation, feature engineering, and performance optimization. Experience working with large-scale structured, semi-structured, or unstructured datasets. Hands-on experience with modern AI technologies, including large language models, embeddings, retrieval systems, and generative AI. Familiarity with frameworks such as Scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, or equivalent tools. Experience evaluating AI outputs and improving model quality, reliability, and business impact. Ability to translate complex problems into measurable, data-driven solutions. A genuine passion for advancing science, improving access to knowledge, and using AI to create meaningful real-world impact. Why Join Elsevier Because your work will matter. You will help build AI systems that support researchers, healthcare professionals, educators, and institutions around the world. Your contributions will help people discover critical evidence, uncover new insights, accelerate innovation, and advance scientific progress. This is an opportunity to work on some of the most challenging and meaningful AI problems anywhere—combining world-class data, cutting-edge technology, and a mission dedicated to improving lives through science and knowledge. U.S. National Base Pay Range: $86,600 - $144,400. Geographic differentials may apply in some locations to better reflect local market rates. jobs.title: Regulatory Reporting Analyst
jobs.jd: SUMMARY The Regulatory Reporting Analyst supports the regulatory reporting function under the direction of the Regulatory Reporting Supervisor. The Analyst applies data manipulation and analytical skills to identify opportunities for process improvement, create and monitor data quality indicators, troubleshoot problems, and develop and implement data reporting solutions. The Analyst uses knowledge of business processes, systems, and databases to improve the overall success of the regulatory reporting function by improving data quality and increasing scalability. In collaboration with the Data and Analytics team, the Analyst defines new data requirements and specifications, and ensures frameworks for data reporting meet the needs of the regulatory reporting department. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES — Work with customers and department personnel as appropriate to understand, define, and document reporting goals, needs, and requirements. Define data requirements for regulatory reporting and work in partnership with the Actuarial Data Team to ensure the availability of adequate data resources to accomplish tasks. Work with business process owners to understand and troubleshoot impacts to regulatory data reporting, and recommend solutions. Develop repeatable data flows and processing steps using enterprise and departmental data sources, BI tools, data development interfaces, and other tools and data sources as needed to accomplish tasks. Act as subject matter expert in moderate scale solution development. Perform data scrubbing, aggregation, grouping, and amendment as needed to meet customer requirements. Develop and implement monitoring tools and reports under the direction of the Regulatory Reporting Manager. Create and maintain technical documentation of processes and workflows, including purpose, data sources, methodology, procedures for updating, intended use, schedules, and quality control items. Apply quality assurance techniques to deliverables to ensure quality of work products, including reconciliation, cross-checking, and peer-review. Design and develop reporting templates and schedules as needed. Develop proficiency with data and reporting tools as required. Maintain confidentiality of data and information as appropriate. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE Bachelor’s degree in actuarial science, mathematics, finance, economics, or related field required. Prior experience or skills may be considered in lieu of a degree. Continuous learning required, as defined by the Company’s learning philosophy. Certification in a relevant discipline, or progress toward certification, is preferred and encouraged. Regulatory Reporting Analyst With proper education, two years of relevant experience which provides the necessary skills, knowledge, and abilities is preferred. Proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, and Access) required. Data analysis experience is preferred. QUALIFICATIONS To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES Skill levels are progressive: • Ability to perform statistical analysis. • Knowledge of mathematics and statistics required to perform necessary computations • Knowledge of database applications • Ability to apply the principles of logical thinking to define problems, collect data, establish facts and draw conclusions • Ability to recognize the impact of business processes and data processing systems to regulatory data and take appropriate action • Ability to effectively exchange information clearly and concisely, present ideas, report facts and other information, and respond to questions as appropriate • Strong oral and written communications skills • Ability to assess the suitability of data and data visualization techniques for an intended purpose • Ability to exercise discretion and independent judgment • Ability to work in a team environment with a diverse portfolio of products and customers • Ability to effectively present complex information and concepts and respond to questions appropriately • Ability to recognize confidential information and intellectual property, and protect appropriately • Proficiency in the use of computers and company standard software specific to position • Ability to meet necessary deadlines • Ability to maintain confidentiality as appropriate ADDITIONAL INFORMATION The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. jobs.title: Power Market Data & Modeling Analyst II – Model Ready Data Team
jobs.jd: Join the Market Leader in Electric Power Data and Analytics Solutions The electrical grid is the largest and most complicated machine ever built. Yes Energy’s industry-leading electric power trading analytics software provides real-time visibility into the massive amount of data generated by the North American electrical grid daily. Our unique and innovative view of the data informs real-time trading decisions and mid-to-long-term investment decisions that keep utility prices low, support the energy transition, and keep the grid running. It’s both challenging work and work with a purpose. Be a part of our successful, growing business during international transformation. Position Summary The Model Ready Data Team builds the modeling data service behind EnCompass, Yes Energy’s power system simulation engine. We produce and maintain the model-ready datasets for North American power systems (generators, load, fuels, transmission, emissions, reserves, and more) that form the baseline for customers’ modeling ecosystems, along with the assumptions documentation that explains every input. We bridge Yes Energy’s Data Platform and Modeling disciplines by translating power system data and historical reports into modeling inputs and supporting the development of proprietary nodal LMP forecasts. As a Power Market Data & Modeling Analyst you will build, validate, and automate those datasets while developing expertise in one or more power markets. Position Details Salary Range: $105,000-$115,000 Location: Hybrid – Boulder, CO; Seattle, WA; or Boston (Newton), MA Full-time Reporting to: Director, Model Ready Data Travel requirements: Occasional travel as needed for client or team collaboration Primary Responsibilities Data Model Development: Build, test, and analyze data models for North American power systems, delivered as model-ready datasets for EnCompass Model Updates: Run regular model-update cycles: refresh generation fleets, load forecasts, fuel prices, interchanges, emissions, reserves, and transmission constraints from internal, public, and commercial sources Technical Optimization: Develop and maintain Python-based automation that ensures data quality from source to product Validation & Benchmarking: Validate models by running simulations, benchmarking results against historical market outcomes, and diagnosing discrepancies Automation : Automate recurring analytics & modeling workflows to increase operational efficiency across departments Documentation: Maintain customer-facing assumptions documentation for each market/region we model Market & Client Expertise: Become an expert in one or more power markets; support clients with case diagnosis and expert advice on power market modeling Continuous Improvement: Identify and research new data sources, tools, and modeling structures to improve model quality and sophistication Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, data science, or a similar quantitative field Understanding of North American power market fundamentals and energy economics Strong technical execution and proven experience using Python (or similar) for data manipulation and automation Comfort working with large, messy tabular data (CSV, Excel, SQL) and checking it against its source A knack for good software and the habits that produce it: version control, code review, testing, and readable code Excellent analytical skills in response to open-ended questions Ability to work efficiently on multiple, non-overlapping tasks with minimal supervision Confidence in presenting technical content to both colleagues and clients Passion for the energy transition Preferred Qualifications Advanced Degree: M.S. or Ph.D. in engineering or computer science with a focus on power systems Simulation Experience: Experience with power system models such as Enelytix, EnCompass, PLEXOS, AURORA, or PROMOD; jobs.jd:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta.  - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We’re looking for someone to join our team in Revenue Strategy & Operations and play a key role in scaling our go-to-market operations. This role is at the intersection of technical problem-solving and operational excellence, focusing on building and maintaining tools, automations, and dashboards that empower our sales, data, and product teams to execute with precision.

The GTM Strategy and Operations team operates as strategic advisors to key cross-functional partners, podded by functional area (pre- vs. post-sale) to drive revenue acceleration, insights, and business growth. This is an exciting opportunity to bring technical and analytical expertise to a fast-paced, impactful environment.

Each Revenue Strategy & Operations team member serves as a dedicated partner to a specific go-to-market function, whether that's SDRs, AEs, Partnerships, or Account Management.

In this role, you will be responsible for:

 - E2E Process Management - Build and maintain strategic automations and standardized processes that support cross-functional teams and promote consistency and adoption.

 - Cross-Functional Collaboration - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive initiatives that enhance revenue generation and operational effectiveness.

 - Leadership Partnership - Serve as a trusted partner to leadership, providing strategic insights, actionable recommendations, and performance reporting.

 - Experimentation - Develop and test new ideas, workflows, and sources that improve critical levers within each functional area.

 - Data-Driven Strategy - Oversee analytics and performance analyses across their associated functions. Identify areas of opportunity and acceleration; build dashboards and insights that inform experimentation and guide lever improvement.

 - Reporting & Analytics - Lead the design and management of dashboards, reports, and key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure and enhance team performance.

Who you are

We're looking for exceptional individuals who combine technical excellence with ethical awareness, who are excited by hard problems and motivated by human impact. You’ll strive with us if you:



 - Are passionate about audio AI driven by a desire to make content universally accessible and breaking the frontiers of new tech.

 - Are a highly motivated and driven individual with a strong work ethic. Our team is aware of this critical moment of audio AI evolution and is committed to going the extra mile to lead.

 - Are analytical, efficient, and strive on solving complex challenges with a first principles mindset.

 - Consistently strive for excellence, delivering high-quality work quickly and exceeding expectations.

 - Take initiative and work autonomously from day one, prioritizing learning and contribution while leaving ego aside.

What you bring

 - 4+ years of Revenue Operations at high-growth technology companies

 - Proven track record of developing and implementing end-to-end solutions, from data collection and analysis to execution.

 - Can break complex problems into smaller, actionable solution steps

 - Strong analytical skills, with proven expertise in SQL and data visualization using BI tools (e.g. Sigma)

 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

 - Highly adaptable, with a proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvement.

 - Strong coachability and willingness to learn and adapt to new challenges.



What we offer

 - High-velocity innovation: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - A truly global team: Collaboration with teammates across 30+ countries, a global customer footprint and office hubs in New York, London and Warsaw. Annual company offsite for the whole team to get together (the last one in Croatia!)

 - Remote first: We prioritize your talent, not your location, with structured asynchronous workflows for maximum impact and minimal meetings.

 - Continuous growth: Collaborate with AI leaders, shape your path, and contribute where you excel most.

jobs.title: Data Analyst - Project Management Support
jobs.jd: Job Summary: The Data Analyst – Project Management Support is an entry-level position located in Budd Lake, NJ responsible for providing data analysis, reporting, and coordination support to project managers and cross-functional teams. The successful candidate will help track project financials, schedules, budgets, milestones, risks, and performance metrics while developing accurate and timely reports for management. Primary Duties & Responsibilities Collect, organize, validate, and analyze project data from multiple sources. Maintain project schedules, action-item logs, risk registers, and status reports. Prepare recurring project updates, dashboards, scorecards, and management reports. Track project progress against schedules, budgets, milestones, and deliverables. Identify schedule variances, cost trends, resource constraints, and potential risks. Support project managers with forecasting, trend analysis, and performance reporting. Assist with tracking purchase orders, invoices, project commitments, and expenditures. Coordinate data inputs from Engineering, Operations, Materials, Supply Chain, Finance, and other functions. Prepare meeting materials, presentations, action items, and follow-up communications. Maintain accurate project documentation and ensure information is current and accessible. Support project changes by tracking scope, schedule, cost, and deliverable updates. Develop ad hoc analyses and reports to support project decisions. Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes, data quality, and project execution. Support lessons-learned activities and continuous improvement initiatives. Education & Experience This position is an excellent opportunity for a recent college graduate with strong financial, analytical, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills. Any relevant work experience is a plus. Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Business, Engineering, Project Management, Finance, Operations, or a related field. Skills Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, pivot tables, lookups, charts, and data organization. Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy. Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines. Ability to work effectively with technical and nontechnical team members. Demonstrated proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
